title: Rejuvenating
body: This app got me back into journaling (and actually enjoying it, not just to check it off my list), gratitude minutes, and being physically active. I didn’t realise how important it was to remember why I was cultivating that habit and the type of person I want to be. Things that had become chores now feel so exciting and fulfilling!
author: Happy Cherries

title: Amazing app
body: I am a coach and I will share this with my clients. The mindset articles are full of valuable knowlege.  The thing I am hoping for in future improvements is to allow the user add more habits. Currently I have 9 habits daily, I wish I could use this app to track & measure but it currently allows up to 3 habits.
author: Cecilia-q
